name: Small Change
note: An articulated MyoHand flips a quarter, rolls it across its knuckles and palms it. Serious anatomy, cheap trick. Choreographed, not trained.

name: The Cheese Heist
note: A rat disarms a mousetrap, steals the cheese, looks back and resets it. An unnecessary favour, choreographed in 3D.

name: Fly Circuit Lab
note: A looming disc drives 16 visual units into a giant-fiber neuron. When it fires, the fly takes off 8 ms later. Lesion it and watch the escape fail. A second circuit brakes the same fly at a sugar dish.

name: Forklift Certified. Somehow.
note: An anatomical fly climbs into a forklift, operates the controls and stacks a pallet. Six legs, one very small shift.

name: Eight Eyes. One Pounce.
note: A code-modeled jumping spider tracks a midge on your choice of three sides, coils, and takes it mid-air on a silk dragline.

name: Not a Robot. Just a Fly.
note: An anatomically detailed fly taps a fictional CAPTCHA and gets verified. Six articulated legs, one very questionable conclusion.

name: Rent My Screen
note: Try your URL or handle on a physical 3D monitor. A private preview of the pay-double concept; payments coming soon.

name: Paint Manchester Red
note: Ignite a handheld flare, pull curling smoke through Manchester, and save your own crimson poster.

name: Mochimo
note: A soft character follows your pointer, leans toward you, and squishes when poked.

name: Magnetic Sand
note: Fine metallic grains gather into sharp peaks, follow your cursor, and settle back into the surface.

name: Fogged Glass
note: Wipe away condensation to reveal an alpine view. Droplets merge, slide, and slowly fog over again.

name: Jelly iPhone
note: A two-phone drop test with soft impacts, tactile motion, and synchronized sound.

name: Jelly Pancake
note: Flip a delightfully wobbly pancake and watch it spring back into shape.

name: Conduit
note: Light terminal-first identity with a usage calculator and status page derived from tested billing math.

name: Fieldline
note: Ledger-first identity with computed per-sqft rates and a 2019-against-2026 compare slider.

name: Hollowpine
note: Serif-italic quiet over an SVG ridgeline, with seasonal rates computed from one multiplier each.

name: Threadline
note: Streetwear in numbered batches with a real cart: drawer island, buy box, and cart page on tested arithmetic.

name: Lumen
note: Serene serif-italic identity where the price list is the pitch and the FAQ needs no JavaScript.

name: Ironline
note: Poster-condensed kinetic identity where the weekly board is a real table drawn from the same data the class pages print.

name: Quire
note: Type-led identity where the specimens are real text at real sizes: waterfalls, a glyph grid, and an axis table per family.

name: Fathom
note: Built as a water column, with a linear depth scale in CSS and a temperature cast drawn as SVG from the same numbers the table prints.

name: Nebula
note: Cosmic identity over an islands architecture: home, features, pricing, docs and changelog, blog, about.

name: Vantage
note: Editorial identity with a kinetic marquee, a horizontal work reel, and a custom cursor.

name: Halcyon
note: A warm-serif product story told on sticky scroll, around an ear cup composed purely in CSS.

name: Fable
note: Warm-dark and playful: magnetic buttons, film grain, marquee, and a playground section.

name: Pulse
note: Poster color-blocking on a neon triad, with a speakers grid, a three-day schedule, and ticket tiers.

name: Cellar
note: Candlelit warm-dark in oxblood and gold, set in Cormorant italic, with a reservations flow.

name: Ledger
note: Trust-clean light theme, pine-green serif identity, tabular numerals, and an SVG balance chart.

name: Atlas
note: Stark monochrome with a cobalt accent, huge Archivo type, CSS-composed plates, and generated project pages.

name: Frequency
note: Nocturnal duotone, oversized Bricolage type against mono liner notes, and album pages with computed runtimes.

name: Sprout
note: Soft pastel blobs on mist white, with a phone mockup and habit-tracker UI composed entirely in CSS.

name: Auralis
note: Domain-warped fractal noise through cosine palettes, WebGPU first with a matched WebGL2 fallback.

name: Gummy
note: One soft specimen in a light studio with dielectric shading: take hold, let go.

name: Drift
note: 65,536 particles riding a curl-noise current on your GPU: drag to spin up vortices.

name: Abyss
note: A Mandelbulb marched live on your GPU: move to steer the orbit and the light.

name: Lichen
note: Gray-Scott chemistry on your GPU: click to seed a colony and watch coral grow from one equation.

name: Undertow
note: A stable-fluids solver on your GPU: drag to stir dye into the current and watch it fold.

name: Mycelia
note: About 262,000 slime-mold agents sensing and steering in four GPU passes per frame, with no CPU in the loop.

name: Puffly
note: A lavender character, soft surfaces and a small gesture of affection.

name: Jalebi
note: Pipe batter, fry a golden coil and dip it in syrup in a real-time GPU experiment.

name: Lunelle
note: Pull the sheer curtains aside and open a window onto a soft sunset sky.

name: Splat Lab
note: Explore a cloud of light, load a local PLY and inspect the rendering frame budget.

name: SIGNAL_07
note: Tune mysterious frequencies and discover strange transmissions.
